create-hierarchical-pdf-bookmarks.title: Create Chapter Bookmarks in a PDF
create-hierarchical-pdf-bookmarks.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts text to locate chapter headings, and adds top‑level bookmarks that navigate to the corresponding pages using GoTo actions.

merge-pdf-bookmarks.title: Merge Bookmarks from One PDF into Another
merge-pdf-bookmarks.description: Demonstrates how to import bookmarks from an external PDF and merge them into an existing PDF while preserving their order using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-csv.title: Extract PDF Bookmarks to CSV
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-csv.description: Shows how to read all bookmarks from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and write their title, destination, and level into a CSV file.

update-bookmark-destination-to-page-10.title: Update PDF Bookmark Destination to a Specific Page
update-bookmark-destination-to-page-10.description: Shows how to locate a bookmark (outline item) in a PDF and change its destination so it points to a given page using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-all-bookmarks-from-pdf.title: Delete All Bookmarks from PDF
delete-all-bookmarks-from-pdf.description: Shows how to remove every bookmark from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor and save the cleaned document.

delete-bookmark-from-pdf.title: Delete a Bookmark from PDF using PdfBookmarkEditor
delete-bookmark-from-pdf.description: Shows how to remove a specific bookmark from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor and then list the remaining bookmarks to confirm the deletion.

add-top-level-blue-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add Top-Level Blue Bookmark to First Page
add-top-level-blue-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a top-level bookmark that points to the first page of a PDF and set its title color to blue using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-subbookmarks-to-pdf-chapter.title: Add Child Bookmarks Under a Parent Bookmark
add-subbookmarks-to-pdf-chapter.description: Shows how to locate an existing parent bookmark in a PDF and add child bookmarks beneath it using Aspose.Pdf's PdfBookmarkEditor facade.

extract-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to JSON
extract-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, extracts its bookmark (outline) hierarchy, converts it into a plain POCO tree, and writes the structure to an indented JSON file.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-xml.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to XML
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF document with PdfBookmarkEditor and export its complete bookmark hierarchy to an XML file for external documentation integration.

import-bookmarks-from-json.title: Import Bookmarks from JSON and Add to PDF
import-bookmarks-from-json.description: Shows how to read bookmark definitions from a JSON file, map them to Aspose.Pdf Bookmark objects, and insert them into a PDF using the PdfBookmarkEditor facade.

add-toc-bookmark-to-pdfs-batch.title: Batch Add Table of Contents Bookmark to PDFs
add-toc-bookmark-to-pdfs-batch.description: Demonstrates iterating over a folder of PDF files, adding a top‑level "Table of Contents" bookmark that points to the first page, and saving the updated documents to an output directory using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-bookmark-count.title: Validate PDF Bookmarks Count Using ExtractBookmarks
validate-pdf-bookmark-count.description: Demonstrates saving a PDF, extracting its bookmarks to an XML file with PdfBookmarkEditor, and verifying that the number of bookmarks matches the expected count.

update-pdf-bookmark-title.title: Add External URL Bookmark to PDF Using MemoryStream
update-pdf-bookmark-title.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array, adds an outline bookmark that opens an external URL, and returns the updated PDF as a byte array using MemoryStream.

add-external-url-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Add External URL Bookmarks to PDF
add-external-url-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create top‑level PDF bookmarks that open external web URLs using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-bookmark-titles-to-title-case.title: Update PDF Bookmark Titles to Title Case
convert-bookmark-titles-to-title-case.description: Demonstrates how to read, modify, and save PDF bookmarks using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, converting each bookmark title to title case while preserving predefined proper nouns.

delete-bookmarks-matching-regex.title: Delete Bookmarks Matching a Regex Pattern
delete-bookmarks-matching-regex.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, extract its bookmarks, and remove those whose titles match a regular expression using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

collapse-specific-pdf-bookmarks.title: Collapse Specific PDF Bookmarks
collapse-specific-pdf-bookmarks.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate outline items by title and set their Open property to false to collapse them, then save the updated document.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-text.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to Text Outline
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-text.description: Shows how to read a PDF's bookmark hierarchy with Aspose.Pdf and write it to a plain‑text file, using indentation to represent each outline level.

import-ofd-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Import OFD Bookmarks into a PDF Document
import-ofd-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an OFD file, extracting (simulated) bookmark data, converting each entry to a PDF outline item, and saving the result as a PDF with bookmarks.

add-javascript-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Actions to PDF Bookmarks
add-javascript-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create top‑level and child bookmarks in a PDF that execute JavaScript code when clicked, using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-delete-bookmarks-from-encrypted-pd.title: Batch Delete Bookmarks from Encrypted PDFs
batch-delete-bookmarks-from-encrypted-pd.description: Demonstrates how to open password‑protected PDFs, remove all bookmark outlines, and save the cleaned files in a batch process.

rename-pdf-bookmarks-using-translation-d.title: Rename PDF Bookmarks Using a Translation Dictionary
rename-pdf-bookmarks-using-translation-d.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, recursively walk through its outline (bookmark) items, replace each title with a translated version from a dictionary, and save the modified document.

validate-pdf-bookmarks-against-toc.title: Compare PDF Bookmarks with Generated Table of Contents
validate-pdf-bookmarks-against-toc.description: The example extracts bookmarks from a PDF using the Aspose.Pdf Facades API, loads a simple TAB‑separated table of contents file, and checks for consistency between bookmark page numbers and TOC entries.

add-image-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Create Bookmarks for Each Image in a PDF
add-image-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF's pages, detect images, and add a bookmark for each image that jumps to the image's page using Aspose.Pdf.

set-bookmark-zoom-level-150-percent.title: Update Bookmark Zoom Level to 150% Magnification
set-bookmark-zoom-level-150-percent.description: Shows how to modify existing PDF bookmarks so that each opens its page at 150% zoom using Aspose.Pdf's PdfBookmarkEditor facade.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-excel.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to CSV for Excel
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-excel.description: Demonstrates how to extract PDF bookmarks using Aspose.Pdf and write them to a CSV file that can be opened in Excel, preserving title, hierarchy level, and destination.

import-bookmarks-from-csv.title: Import Bookmarks from CSV into PDF
import-bookmarks-from-csv.description: Shows how to read a CSV file and add each line as a PDF bookmark using Aspose.Pdf's PdfBookmarkEditor.

create-bookmark-to-named-destination.title: Create Bookmark to Named Destination
create-bookmark-to-named-destination.description: Demonstrates how to add a PDF bookmark that links to an existing named destination using Aspose.Pdf. The bookmark is added to the document outline and saved.

remove-duplicate-bookmarks.title: Remove Duplicate Bookmarks from PDF
remove-duplicate-bookmarks.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a PDF's outline collection, identify bookmarks with identical titles and destinations, and delete the duplicates using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-reviewed-bookmark-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add "Reviewed" Bookmark to PDFs
batch-add-reviewed-bookmark-to-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, add a top‑level "Reviewed" bookmark that jumps to the last page, and save the updated documents using Aspose.Pdf.

add-colored-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Color PDF Bookmarks by Section Type
add-colored-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, walk through its bookmark hierarchy, and set bookmark colors to red for warning sections and green for informational sections based on keywords in the titles.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.title: Export PDF Bookmark Hierarchy to JSON
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.description: Shows how to extract a PDF's bookmark tree using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and write each bookmark's title, level, and page number to a formatted JSON file.

import-bookmarks-from-database.title: Import Bookmarks from Database into PDF
import-bookmarks-from-database.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, reading bookmark data from a DataTable (simulating a database query), creating GoTo actions, and adding the bookmarks to the document outline before saving.
